protocol.status: Post hoc retained-minimum selection declared before its independent replay
protocol.selection: ALL 36 original problems; select numerical_valid AND physical_valid retained candidate by minimum max_error, then maximum worst_logB, then ascending candidate index
protocol.classification: Original inner 0.00748 plus 1e-10 comparison tolerance; outer 0.0075 and actual log(1.01) without added tolerance; retain all numerical and label discrepancies
protocol.comparison: Compare cached grid-41 DP minimax J and deployed economic-policy maximum errors separately against this retained local-search minimum. No global continuous optimum claim.
protocol.preservation: Supplementary replay only; do not replace original selected/economic plan, audit, classification flip or costs
